title: ocg-document-span@1
description: Sidecar span record (SPEC.md section 23 sidecar profile): one input value bound to this document at this location. The record is adjacent evidence, never an input to any execution_hash preimage. Ships OUTSIDE the envelope by design: the section 23 type list stays closed at four.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer evaluated against policy_parameters (SPEC.md section 23 binding rule, unchanged). Empty string names the whole policy_parameters object.

source_ref.description: File name only, never a path (no / or \ separator), following the basename rule.

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the raw document file bytes, lower-case hex, no prefix.

record.description: Zero-based DATA record index after an RFC 4180 parse; the header row is not a data record.

header.description: The header name at this column index; an ordinary string even when it collides with an Object.prototype member name.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer into the JSON document.

tool_id.description: The parser node id, so which parser read the value is as pinned as everything else.

kernel_digest.description: The extractor kernel's identity digest; must resolve to an entry in the site's published kernel digest list (registry/kernel/).

lexical.description: The extracted string exactly as the document bytes decode, byte for byte. Omitted only in a future private-input variant; v1 refuses that combination.

normalization.description: The declared rule that turns lexical into the input value. Closed list of four. Refusal first: anything outside the declared grammar is refused, never guessed.
